categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Wondux Environmental Protection Technology Corp. primarily operates in advanced environmental protection technology equipment development, system integration, and comprehensive environmental solutions. Its main business segments focus on organic waste treatment and industrial wastewater treatment, with additional activities in ecological restoration and other wastewater treatment services. The company also engages in BOT projects and entrusted operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes core technologies including high-efficiency anti-fouling MBR systems combined with nanofiltration and reverse osmosis, intelligent two-stage DTRO membrane treatment, electrochemical and biological coupling deep treatment, low-consumption evaporation, and high-impact resistant biological wastewater treatment. It also develops technologies for difficult-to-degrade organic pollutants, salt separation and resource recovery, precise leachate drainage and treatment, in-situ landfill oxygenation and stabilization, groundwater remediation, and biological conversion of kitchen waste into protein. Production involves project-based manufacturing of modular technical equipment and integrated mobile treatment devices, with strict quality control at key process nodes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves primarily government entities and large industrial enterprises, including energy, mining, coal chemical, petrochemical, and automotive sectors. Its projects cover municipal solid waste treatment, industrial wastewater zero discharge and resource recovery, and urban environmental comprehensive services. The customer base is nationwide in China, with plans to expand internationally leveraging strategic partnerships.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in China, with significant revenue from North China and East China regions. The company has projects and subsidiaries across multiple provinces including Jiangsu, Tianjin, Shanxi, Anhui, Hebei, Qinghai, and Inner Mongolia. It plans to expand its urban environmental services to regions where its controlling shareholder, Chery Group, has production bases, and to international markets leveraging Chery's export footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wondux operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain, focusing on technology development, equipment manufacturing, system integration, project implementation, and operation services. It extends upstream into materials and technology development through R&D and strategic investments, aiming for vertical integration in resource recycling and green materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in advanced wastewater and solid waste treatment technologies, resource recovery, and green materials, including lithium extraction from brine and battery recycling. It pursues technology iteration, integration of biochemical and physicochemical processes, and development of energy-efficient, low-carbon solutions aligned with China's dual carbon goals. Strategic collaboration with academic institutions and industry partners supports innovation and commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of environmental protection equipment and integrated solutions, project contracting (EPC), entrusted operation services, and BOT projects where the company invests, constructs, operates, and maintains facilities, recovering costs and earning returns via service fees. The company also earns income from government subsidies and technology licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Wondux is positioned as a leading player in China's environmental protection industry, particularly in leachate treatment and industrial wastewater zero discharge. It is recognized as a benchmark enterprise in solid waste leachate treatment and industrial wastewater resource recovery. The company competes with other large environmental engineering firms and technology providers, leveraging its comprehensive service capabilities, strong R&D, and strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 621.6 million, a 23.24% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 74.2 million. Despite revenue decline, project gross margin improved by 7.92 percentage points. The company maintains positive operating cash flow and continues investing in R&D, with a 5.14% R&D-to-revenue ratio. It has total assets of about RMB 2.08 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.03 billion, reflecting a medium-sized enterprise with ongoing growth and restructuring.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wondux differentiates itself through its integrated environmental solutions combining advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive project execution capabilities, and strong R&D innovation. It offers full-process, full-quantity, and full-chain solutions for organic solid waste and industrial wastewater treatment, emphasizing high efficiency, low energy consumption, and resource recovery. The company’s strategic alignment with major industrial groups and focus on green materials and circular economy enhance its competitive edge.
